rationale: Raw reads recovered exactly from the deposited count table (one scale factor per column, integrality 100%). The paper's replication-competent HIV library passages for 15 days in CEM-M7 cells across three independent infections (n=1,2,3, untreated arm), and antiviral-factor guides enrich over the virus-stock input; this reproduces the deposited '15dpi untreated vs input N 1-3' MAGeCK comparison. Each infection has its own input, so the replicate term pairs them. Direction is enriched. NT is the non-targeting control gene.
